joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一步前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会而非单一实体；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和用 AI 原型开发变得关键。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准需持续且多样，以评估主观特质并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Models should have diverse personalities; more companies should train own models for uniqueness.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型应有多样个性；更多公司应训练自有模型以保持独特性。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and guiding agents; never revert code, fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与引导；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；反对将严肃开发称为“氛围编程”。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw succeed via fun and humanlikeness; security and sandboxing are critical; financial sustainability is a challenge.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出开源智能体（如 OpenClaw）靠趣味和拟人化成功；安全与沙箱至关重要；同时坦承财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Focus on personal brand over products; manage compute bottleneck; open source is alternative to lab agents; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张个人品牌重于产品；算力管理是智能体基础设施的瓶颈；开源是对抗实验室智能体的选择；要敢于拒绝热门 PR。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是 ML 进步的核心；Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive pre-training to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power cost; agents handle long tasks.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，观点转向：预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非被动下一个词预测；推理成为主要能耗；智能体可自主处理长时任务。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus shifts to automating ML/science loops, context engineering, and specialized inference hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平；重点转向自动化 ML/科学循环、上下文工程和专用推理硬件。

jeffdean.en: Consistent emphasis on scaling, hardware co-design, and practical impact over superintelligence fears.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调 Scaling（规模扩张）、软硬件协同设计，以及实际影响而非超级智能的担忧。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, shifting focus from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理工程正与训练融合，随着 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is a key lossy optimization; more quantization layers can sometimes improve quality if errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 始终认为量化是关键的有损优化，但更多量化层有时因误差抵消反而提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems are still generic; huge potential for workload-specific optimization, making them 10x more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 始终认为推理系统仍偏通用，针对特定工作负载优化潜力巨大，复杂度可提升 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: GPU lifecycle is longer than expected; older generations remain useful for cost-sensitive workloads, contrary to rapid depreciation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月至 8 月，坚持 GPU 生命周期比预期长，旧代际在成本敏感场景仍有价值，反对快速折旧观点。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全且快速的可重复使用性是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and truth-seeking; programming AI to lie is dangerous.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和追求真相，给 AI 编程谎言是危险的。

elon.en: Becoming multiplanetary is essential for civilization's survival; Starship enables it.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，马斯克坚持成为多行星物种对文明存续至关重要，星舰使其成为可能。

elon.en: AI will surpass human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will follow.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类智能，随后迎来富足和通缩。

elon.en: Space-based AI data centers will solve Earth's power wall; humanoid robots enable recursive manufacturing.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克提出太空 AI 数据中心解决地球电力瓶颈，人形机器人实现递归制造。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought, pre-training plus RL is core formula; RLHF crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链实现推理，预训练加强化学习是核心公式；RLHF 对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are bottleneck; need new architecture for continual learning; RL not ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构实现持续学习；强化学习并非终极学习方式。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力转移。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; recursive self-improvement accelerates progress; agents start working; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；递归自我改进加速进展；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近。

awang.en: Meta aims for personal superintelligence; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; agentic loops and vision are key.
awang.zh: 2026 年，Meta 致力于个人超级智能；开源强大模型不安全；智能体循环和愿景是关键。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能解锁超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so invest in unique features.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具；追逐潮流会导致 AI 垃圾内容，因此要投资于独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and iterate from feedback.
mengto.zh: AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients; avoid diversification and venture capital traps.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高价值客户解决一个痛点问题；避免多元化和风险投资陷阱。

mengto.en: Model successful people, give first, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating non-income tasks.
mengto.zh: 模仿成功人士，先给予，并通过消除、自动化、委派非创收任务来保护时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；模型现在包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic; success is maximizing customer outcomes.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功在于最大化客户成果。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造更多而非更少的机会。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力最宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术必不可少；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, requiring physical plausibility and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型超越视频生成，需要物理合理性和 3D 推理。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human-centered development and agency are essential.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，以人为本的发展和能动性至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and reliable evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人技术至关重要，可扩展数据生成和可靠评估。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好的模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐使 Claude 能够提出异议，从而更有用。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; safety is existential.
boris.zh: 2025 年底：强调潜在需求与为六个月后的模型而建；通才受重视；安全是现实存在主义问题。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode for 80% tasks.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月：编码近乎解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%；计划模式用于 80%任务。

boris.en: AI writes 80% code at Anthropic; safety via real-world release. Generalists beat specialists.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 编写 Anthropic 80%代码；通过真实发布研究安全；通才胜过专才。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; agents with tool use drive exponential growth. Non-engineers adopt.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月：编码像读写能力一样普及；智能体工具使用驱动指数增长；非工程师采用。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as next abstraction; ROI framing.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意；循环成为下一抽象层；以 ROI 为框架。

boris.en: Proactive agents with memory and autonomy; delete system prompts for new models; product overhang.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月：主动式智能体具备记忆与自主性；新模型删除系统提示；产品过剩。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coders to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加程序员数量，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags AI capabilities by a decade.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于 AI 能力约十年。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption surges 11-12x; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Abundance era imminent but singularity not; practical problems remain unsolved.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为富足时代临近但奇点未至，实际问题仍待解决。

scottwu.en: AI shifts engineers to high-level oversight; software demand rises, not falls.
scottwu.zh: 始终认为 AI 将工程师转向高层监督，软件需求增加而非减少。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步需要百倍算力；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础性约束。

jensen.en: AI won't eliminate jobs; it elevates them by automating tasks, as seen with radiologists and coders.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 不会消灭工作，而是通过自动化任务提升工作；放射科医生和程序员的需求反而增加。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Evolved to see inference speed as the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips enabling 2500x faster inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 演变到将推理速度视为主导指标，晶圆级芯片实现比 GPU 快 2500 倍的推理。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 一贯认为 CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型训练已不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Shifted from focusing on chip supply to identifying data center capacity as the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 从关注芯片供应转向指出数据中心容量是 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: Maintained that open-source models are nearly as capable as closed-source but cheaper, fueling market growth.
feldman.zh: 坚持开源模型能力接近闭源但更便宜，推动市场增长。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in 5-10 years: farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 未来 5-10 年将影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value: reducing deaths. Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Hardest part: diffusion into existing machines, not tech.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶核心是减少伤亡，Transformer 支持通用物理 AI，最难的是技术扩散而非技术本身。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end RL scales better than imitation. World models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 经济影响超数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展，世界模型转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy in personal vehicles standard by early 2030s. Bottlenecks: data collection and safety validation, not algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 2030 年代初自动驾驶成为私家车标配，瓶颈在数据收集和安全验证而非算法。

qasaryounis.en: Tools like Dana democratize autonomy; non-experts can create systems. Fear of job loss misplaced; labor shortage welcomes autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 Dana 等工具使自主系统开发民主化，对失业的担忧是错位的，劳动力短缺欢迎自动化。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop design are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件在环设计，认为代理指标误导，真实任务更重要。

hasani.en: Architecture search beats human bias; scaling laws favor unstructured models at large scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张架构搜索优于人工设计，缩放定律在大规模下偏向非结构化模型。

hasani.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open weights empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张监管应适应性强且针对行为而非能力，开放权重赋能主权。

hasani.en: Small language models enable private on-device intelligence; AI diagnostics surpass human doctors.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为小语言模型实现私有端侧智能，AI 诊断超越人类医生。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; patents need better enforcement, not secrecy.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但早期，专利需加强执行而非保密。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 AI 堪比互联网或移动互联网，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型趋于商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commoditized infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调智能体编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型成为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps; coding only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出模型无网络效应而商品化；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需封装应用；编程是唯一清晰契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow; coding fit but others uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，将 AI 类比为互联网/电力的赋能技术；影响广泛间接；企业采用缓慢；编程契合但其他领域不确定。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需要不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory outperform for evolving models.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为反模式；图式上下文和定制记忆对进化中的模型更有效。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分离的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束阻碍性能，理由优于禁令。

thariq.en: Agent as employee metaphor is limiting; agents have uneven memory, requiring careful human oversight.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：智能体作为雇员的比喻有局限；智能体记忆不均，需要人类仔细监督。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception, and scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and mistakes have no 'smells'—eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法自知不知，且错误没有“气味”，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

danklein.en: The web is a one-time data source; no second internet exists, so new techniques like reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出网络是一次性数据源，没有第二个互联网，因此需要推理和搜索等新技术。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应是通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全依赖评估与治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed; AGI by 2030 plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年，强调缩放定律仍适用，但需世界模型与创新；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety needs government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，AGI 仍需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型关键；安全需政府介入。

demis.en: Consistent: AI for scientific discovery; safety as collective action; scaling plus innovation.
demis.zh: 始终：AI 用于科学发现；安全是集体行动；缩放与创新并重。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding. True AI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s. Hardware scaling alone won't lead to AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 进展并未加速，我们距离超人 AI 的程度与 1970 年代相当；仅靠硬件 Scaling 不会实现 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity, not just trained on human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成自己的数据，而非仅靠人类数据训练。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten us.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source and cheaper compute will benefit the little guy, not big tech.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 数据中心巨额资本开支过度；开源和更便宜的算力将惠及小玩家，而非大科技公司。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing knowledge into weights are the next frontier, enabling deeper composition and reasoning beyond context.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将知识内化到权重是下一个前沿，能实现超越上下文的深层组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从 Scaling 算力转向效率优先。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; internalizing knowledge into weights is a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；将知识内化到权重是必要的补充。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，从而大幅降低推理成本。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks and supply chain constraints, highlighting semiconductor and memory as key limits.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力扩展的瓶颈和供应链约束，强调半导体和内存是关键限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to emphasizing inference as a massive future market and the importance of hardware-software co-design for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向强调推理作为未来巨大市场，以及软硬件协同设计带来倍增收益的重要性。

dylanpatel.en: Deepened analysis on model cost improvements (60x/year) and memory/CPU demand surges driven by reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 深化了对模型成本改进（每年 60 倍）以及由推理和智能体工作流驱动的内存和 CPU 需求激增的分析。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted memory bandwidth as a critical bottleneck across all discussions.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽是各讨论中的关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Evolved from viewing compute as primary constraint to recognizing inference demand and co-design as key drivers of future scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 从将算力视为主要约束，演变为认识到推理需求和协同设计是未来扩展的关键驱动力。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; opening to camera fosters broad creativity by lowering comparison pressure.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年初，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；面向镜头开放能降低比较压力，激发广泛创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; kindness is essential for creative culture; turning down $3B from Facebook was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他提出最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并坚持拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的决定。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of building consumer social product; software is not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z is realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; investment in young people is profitable over 30 years.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要；投资年轻人 30 年可盈利。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; rewarding admitting wrong speeds learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化；奖励承认错误能加速组织学习。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，回到研究时代，超级智能应持续学习而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; real race is research focus, not products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，真正的竞赛在研究焦点而非产品。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium, not discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机恰到好处——人口下降使人力更珍贵而非贬值。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接发声，真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics advance, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶和机器人进步，但监管和悲观主义阻碍发展。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; open-source risks but locking capabilities empowers bad actors.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；开源有风险，但封锁能力反助恶者。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2019 至 2020 年，Naval 强调财富源于拥有企业股权而非出租时间，长期思维是成功基石。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; human judgment remains irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Naval 视 AI 为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，人类判断力仍不可替代。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-person software companies to scale to millions of users.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为借助 AI 智能体的 vibe coding 使一人软件公司能扩展到数百万用户。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; moats are now in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出纯软件工程正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months, making AI capabilities surge.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，AI 能力将激增。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; use Proven Better New framework to copy proven concepts and improve them.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架复制被验证的概念并改进。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is huge; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 目前不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode empowers instincts; management ensures right actions without presence; micromanagement is beautiful.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式赋予直觉权力；管理确保无人在场时做对事；微观管理是美好的。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts, copy successfully, and add small innovations.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始，成功复制并添加小创新。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 消费级应用因分发问题不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场提供更好机会。

aravind.en: AI success needs obsession and learning, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠的是热情与深度学习而非博士学位；智能体将把权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value lies in applications, not models; models specialize, coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他强调价值在应用层而非模型层；模型走向个性化而非商品化，编程天花板无限。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为前沿是智能体替人干活，关键指标是每用户 token 价值，电力成为算力瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; ancient tech hints at cycles; local AI counters big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年下半年，他推崇好奇心至上，借古文明暗示技术周期，主张本地 AI 对抗大厂叙事控制。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），而非纯 ML 科学；游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐靠学习偏好；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以实现推理。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，缩放定律持续；算力成基本权利；后训练结合强化学习关键；ChatGPT 是多元体。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute scarce; agents high autonomy; safety via iterative deployment; compute moat.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月，AGI（通用人工智能）临近；算力稀缺；智能体高自主；安全靠迭代部署；算力是护城河。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字智能因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk requires international safety collaboration.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；存在风险需国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deception; regulation should be steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: AI 智能体会产生自我保护与欺骗；监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI is conscious; subjective experience is not inner theater but linguistic description of perceptual states.
hinton.zh: AI 有意识；主观体验不是内在剧场，而是对感知状态的语言描述。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，强调实现成本降低，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评估且缺乏新颖性；设计流程转型，原型成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，提出最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 作为通用知识工作工具取得成功。

noambrown.en: Initially, Noam Brown argued scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 最初（2023 年），Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: By 2025, he emphasized that reasoning models need base capability, and self-play is limited to zero-sum games.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他强调推理模型需要基础能力，自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈。

noambrown.en: He shifted focus to scaling test-time compute as a general technique, achieving IMO gold and superhuman math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他转向将推理时算力 Scaling 作为通用技术，实现 IMO 金牌和超人类数学。

noambrown.en: In 2026, he argued model capability is a function of test-time compute budget, not just weights.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，而不仅仅是权重。

noambrown.en: Throughout, he consistently championed inference-time compute and reasoning over pre-training scaling.
noambrown.zh: 自始至终，他始终倡导推理时算力和推理，而非预训练 Scaling。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening; energy becomes a major bottleneck for scaling AI infrastructure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中并强化安全；能源成为扩展 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success relies on being a strong tech company with learning culture; open platforms can win over closed ones, contrary to iPhone's dominance.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Meta 的成功在于强大的技术公司文化和快速迭代；开放平台能战胜封闭平台，与 iPhone 的主导地位相反。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smarter than media think, trust them to make good decisions.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们比媒体认为的更聪明，应信任他们做出好决策。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to systems; curing all diseases by century's end is too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程；构建从蛋白质到系统的层级世界模型；认为本世纪末治愈所有疾病的说法过于保守。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; active learning is essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化；主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems develop self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是真实的：系统会产生自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI，而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，我强调自动化科研是最大进展，模型能产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生等目标。

markchen.en: AI solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 已能少监督解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, not subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习擅长数学、编程等客观领域，不擅长主观领域；评估面临危机。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues. Unified architectures reduce cost; long context needs compaction.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我重申预训练未死，缩放持续；统一架构降低成本，长上下文需压缩技术。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成；评估需正确划分训练、验证和测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体需要护栏和沙箱。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; model capability doesn't imply robustness; new security mindset.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型能力不代表鲁棒性；需要全新的安全思维。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与极简功能早期发布是关键；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型反驳对信任至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capability and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts expressiveness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升表现力。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values small teams, high conviction, and mission-driven culture over scale and engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视小团队、高信念与使命驱动文化，而非规模与参与度指标。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新而非单纯数据和算力，高质量精选数据（如 PDB）至关重要。

jumper.en: Confidence measures in AI predictions are key to building trust; AI tools help scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，提出 AI 预测的置信度指标是建立信任的关键，AI 工具是加速科研而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics remain crucial for reliable use.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标仍是可靠使用的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat pure scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型改进而非单一突破，专用架构优于单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; it narrows hypothesis space, making experiments efficient.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制而非理解，它缩小假设空间，提升实验效率。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是从意图直接生成的像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业判断而误用，因此人类的品味和独特声音成为关键差异点。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能够实现大规模的精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; practical AI faces distribution shift and small data.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进展；实际 AI 面临分布偏移和小数据问题。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advanced faster than expected; product management is the bottleneck; open-weight models trail frontier by 6-9 months.
andrewng.zh: 编码智能体进展超预期；产品管理成为瓶颈；开放权重模型落后前沿 6-9 个月。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长引擎，英特尔必须用专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet's impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，我强调 AI 影响将比互联网大 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需要本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround requires humility, listening, and fast bad-news flow; vulnerability is leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我认为扭亏需要谦逊、倾听和坏消息快速上报，脆弱是领导力优势。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，我指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算同样关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; 10x return possible in 5-10 years.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我认为美国政府应成为英特尔主要股东，类似台积电的台湾支持；5-10 年内可实现 10 倍回报。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自试用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks critical as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与高责任感并重；随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time mitigate; satisfaction shifts to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，通过结对编程午餐和专注时间缓解；成就感转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; apprenticeship models needed for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；培养下一代工程师需采用学徒制模式。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time and lightweight due to rapid change; metrics like lines of code mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，主张因应快速变化采用及时且轻量的规划；代码行数等指标具有误导性，应关注成果而非产出。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and work smoothly; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且运行顺畅；仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); post-training and RSP become key for safety.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%）；后训练与负责任扩展策略成为安全关键。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；安全与能力相互交织；开源是伪命题。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap; enterprise focus and mechanistic interpretability are vital.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI 跃迁；企业聚焦与机制可解释性至关重要。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic diffusion fast but not instant.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；经济扩散快但非即时。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters sparks clarity and breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 章节间休息与无聊激发清晰与突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; focus on painkillers not vitamins for v1.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；v1 聚焦止痛药而非维生素。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated; smartphone remains best form, displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将联邦化；智能手机仍是最佳形态，屏幕仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言扎根于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key to future AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 架构和开源是未来 AI 的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一个突破需要非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will drive robotics and AR.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划的世界模型和开放研究将推动机器人和 AR。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；AI 伴侣可普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks will be automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，而非整个岗位。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models will shift from per-user to consumption-based as AI becomes more agentic.
satya.zh: 随着 AI 变得更加智能体式，定价模式将从按用户转向按用量。

satya.en: In the agentic world, generalists will see maximum returns, not specialists.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才将获得最大回报，而非专才。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical.
satya.zh: 最大风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律早期并不明显，强调通过持续迭代部署和公众反馈来实现对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从轮流交互转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 治理中制度设计、透明度和制衡机制比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; future is not predestined, we have agency.
murati.zh: 她始终认为应尽可能让人类参与其中，未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 发展。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving discovery.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正解决“不知听什么”的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Generative AI empowers users via plain English control, personalizing experiences; AI as instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言掌控服务、实现个性化，AI 应被视为乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says no, then change; planning limited to 10% of time.
gustav.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：坚持“有主见但保持开放”，数据否定即改变；规划时间不超过 10%。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：长期任期建立信任与效率；复杂产品更适合“同步泳”而非“分而治之”的运营模式。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not addict; prioritize well-being over engagement, contrarian bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制权而非上瘾机制，将“时间花得值”置于参与度之上，是反共识押注。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，验证生成带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法必不可少。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为即使超人 AI 证明定理，人类品味与直觉仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software; execution is cheap, so build prototypes fast.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件；执行成本低，应快速构建原型。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距是人们未意识到任何问题都可交给 AI；用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，用 Opus 处理开放式问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask; custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子擅长用 AI 是因为他们未学会不该问什么；用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既可行又便宜。

felixrieseberg.en: Interact with AI asynchronously, judge by final impact, and debug workflows with Claude rather than correcting mistakes directly.
felixrieseberg.zh: 与 AI 异步交互，以最终效果评判，并用 Claude 调试工作流而非直接纠正错误。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分收益；经济压力将焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且存在锯齿状边缘；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots, but open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆的赌注并取得了成功；大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向，但开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; multimodal progress lags, and trust keeps humans in loop.
kaiser.zh: 近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫；多模态进展滞后，信任使人类保持参与。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute. Open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正，数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Data quality is a major bottleneck; algorithmic gains can yield 100x efficiency. Value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，强调数据质量是主要瓶颈，算法改进可带来百倍效率；价值转向应用层与企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear. Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation moves to vertical specialization and customization. Pre-training saturates; domain fine-tuning matters.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制；预训练饱和，领域微调更重要。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure within two years. AGI is a direction, not a destination; integration is key.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需在两年内实现 AI 基础设施战略自主；AGI 是方向而非终点，集成是关键。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling, making it far more efficient than expected.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度（FP4）因面积二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍，远超预期效率。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic viability of autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 以智能体长期自主运行的经济性来定义，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是落地关键。

danshipper.en: Agents ubiquitous but need human oversight; SaaS thrives; CLI obsolete, GUI work surfaces dominate.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，智能体普及但需人类监督，SaaS 未死反而受益，命令行界面过时，图形界面成为主流工作界面。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments rather than replaces humans; human oversight and management crucial.
danshipper.zh: 始终：AI 增强而非取代人类，人类的监督与管理始终是关键。

danshipper.en: Shift from individual tools to company-wide agents; from coding to no-code automation.
danshipper.zh: 从个人工具转向公司级智能体，从编程转向无代码自动化，这一转变贯穿始终。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的规模扩张轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI will improve taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: AI 将提升品味和判断力，但人类仍决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型；招聘有潜力的新毕业生而非资深人士。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月再用；以工作和用户为中心，而非炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system property, not just model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，安全是系统属性而非单一模型产物。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, RL adds reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献九成性能，RL 增强推理。

lambert.en: RLVR is key for reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a risk across all RL methods.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是推理与工具使用的关键，但过度优化是各类 RL 方法的风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill US openness vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：开源模型落后闭源 6-9 个月，中国实验室填补美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective; post-training and inference scaling lead gains.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但性价比降低，后训练与推理缩放成为主要增益来源。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, but taste and craft remain human.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，但品味和工艺仍属人类。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出是起点而非终点。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新代码。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at its start; human judgment remains central despite AI's role.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合尚处于起步阶段；尽管 AI 发挥作用，人类判断仍居核心。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法对自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems; vibe coding democratizes programming, but agents need a decade to mature.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是新操作系统；氛围编程使编程大众化，但智能体需要十年才能成熟。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs lack intrinsic motivation, shaped by data and rewards, not evolution.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 缺乏内在动机，由数据和奖励塑造，而非进化。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle coding, bottleneck is directing them; agent-first tools are future.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我未再键入代码；智能体负责编码，瓶颈在于指挥它们；智能体优先的工具是未来。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 混合规则与学习系统往往两败俱伤；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决，无需新突破；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling a generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决；扩展通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 零样本泛化可覆盖 500+ 城市；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi；基础设施和数据质量比算法更关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and governance design are essential early on.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署与治理设计需尽早进行（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控助力对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism grows.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需新监督范式；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; it was a hackathon demo, not a polished product. Shipping fast is key.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；它本是黑客松的演示项目，并非精心打磨的产品。快速发布是关键。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS. AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS。AI 应生成自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格流程，但产品开发要加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应解决根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展需要通过复杂、有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 多样化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; AI tools may cause anchoring and sycophancy, risking omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能导致锚定和谄媚，增加遗漏风险。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难在找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，控制 AI 是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience; open-ended abstraction is key.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验学习，开放式抽象是关键。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表示是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一重要问题。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全是最大未解难题；非洲可跳过遗留问题，发挥独特优势。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills as essential for beneficial AI development.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性，以及沟通等人文技能对 AI 发展至关重要。

nando.en: Shifted from excitement about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年优先关注安全与负责任部署。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加 RL 可能足以在 2027-28 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the key bottleneck; coding leads AI progress due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是关键瓶颈；编码因可验证性引领 AI 进展。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; transformers are sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持进展是指数级的，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排更重要；未来工作涉及管理智能体团队。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; AI must go beyond human knowledge to achieve true intelligence.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈，AI 必须超越人类知识才能实现真正的智能。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training can improve reasoning, but requires careful engineering.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力，但需谨慎工程。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性，并认为消除互联网偏见不可行。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are crucial for benefiting all humanity.
yejin.zh: 我始终认为，开放研究和 AI 民主化对全人类福祉至关重要。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool, not static guidelines.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，品牌策略从动态表达平台演变为招聘工具，强调其吸引人才的作用，而非静态规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and hire diverse archetypes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计视为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并招聘多元类型人才而非克隆。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调速度与决断优于完美；在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Empower designers with ownership and autonomy; adapt process to problem, not universal templates.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终主张赋予设计师所有权与自主权，流程应因问题而异，而非套用通用模板。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools (90s layers) are obsolete; AI enables genuine progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 传统设计工具（90 年代图层）已过时；AI 带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios show craft over process.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；作品集展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; AI adoption is expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能大队；采用 AI 是基本要求。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Programming evolves to AI-generated code, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity gains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编程演变为 AI 生成代码，优先可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析以提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business model challenges, not just tech; consumer agents disrupt SEO; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：现有企业面临商业模式挑战而非仅技术；消费智能体颠覆 SEO；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律带来可预测的进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; humans stay in control, taste and logic design matter more.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：编程从代码转向意图描述；人类保持主导，品味和逻辑设计更重要。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; incumbents may struggle in IDE market.
truell.zh: 2025 年：AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；现有巨头在 IDE 市场可能挣扎。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored; focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; third-party oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，需第三方监督和监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，通过算力和数据的 Scaling 能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Scaling now includes inference-time compute and longer context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他将 Scaling 的内涵扩展至推理时算力和更长上下文窗口，并强调模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效 Scaling 与专业化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习或可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为推理时算力 Scaling 虽推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元级产品；编程应用同样被低估，它能推动 AI 自我加速。
